title: Recording: Winter Rose, Love Awake by Wings | 1978
content:
Spirit of Ranachan Studio, Low Ranachan Farm, Campbeltown, Scotland
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas
Engineers: Phil McDonald, Mark Vigars, Tim Summerhayes

Wings began recording two songs for the Back To The Egg album on 12 July 1978.

The songs were ‘Winter Rose’ and ‘Love Awake’. Although presented as a pair on the album, they were recorded separately.

The basic track for ‘Winter Rose’ had Paul McCartney on piano, Denny Laine and Laurence Juber on acoustic guitars, and Steve Holley on drums.

Recording continued over the next few days, although precise recording information is not known. McCartney added bass guitar and harpsichord, Laine overdubbed 12-string acoustic guitar, and Holley recorded more percussion.

‘Love Awake’ had McCartney and Laine on acoustic guitars, Juber was on bass guitar, and Holley played drums. Paul also sang a guide vocal and Linda McCartney played Mellotron.
